name: theme-from-design
description: Turn a store design into a Shopify Online Store 2.0 theme: the plugin creates a valid theme skeleton (layout, header/footer section groups, JSON templates, base sections, settings with your brand colours and fonts, en + zh-CN locales); the agent writes sections from the design; every change is checked (Liquid syntax, section schemas, setting references, JSON template references) and the full check runs Shopify's theme-check offline. Preview pages with sample products next to the design at desktop and mobile widths, then package a zip for upload. Shopify only; no store login or upload.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 把店铺设计稿做成 Shopify Online Store 2.0 主题：插件生成合规的主题骨架（layout、页眉/页脚 section 组、JSON 模板、基础 sections、带品牌色和字体的主题设置、英文和简体中文语言包），Agent 按设计稿写 section；每次修改都检查 Liquid 语法、section schema、设置引用和 JSON 模板引用，完整检查会离线运行 Shopify 官方 theme-check。面板用样例商品把页面渲染出来，与设计稿并排对照（桌面/手机），最后打包成可上传的 zip。仅支持 Shopify，不登录、不上传店铺。
